source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Under [Acts of Faith](vsdata:ability/adepta-sororitas.acts-of-faith), an army with the **ADEPTA SORORITAS** Army Faction gains 1 Miracle die:

- as each turn starts
- each time 1 of its **ADEPTA SORORITAS** units is **destroyed**

Roll a D6 for each Miracle die gained: the result is its value, which only a rule that says so can change or re-roll. Keep these dice aside as your Miracle dice pool.
